name: MUS02_HOUSE_TRANSITION_READY_CANDIDATE
rationale: HOME's eight-beat harmonic clauses are F/Em7/Am7, Dm7/Gm11, Cmaj7/E7, then Am7/Ab7/Gm7/C7. A new phrase-ending release and breath makes those clauses independently redirectable. The original E carry into the next F statement is explicitly replaced with a phrase-ending release in this new arrangement. Four-beat turnaround132 is the existing full-cycle boundary, not a new per-bar policy.
